words.enDefinition: Fresh fruit and vegetables sold as food

examples.en: I stopped for fresh produce on my way back from the university library.
examples.zh: 我从学校图书馆回来的路上顺便买了些「新鲜蔬果」。

examples.en: The shop near my flat puts the fresh produce beside the entrance every morning.
examples.zh: 我住处附近的店每天早上都会把「新鲜蔬果」摆在入口旁。

words.enDefinition: Fruit and vegetables sold without fixed packaging

examples.en: I bought loose produce because I only needed two pears and one pepper.
examples.zh: 我只要两个梨和一个甜椒，所以买了「散装蔬果」。

examples.en: The shop has separate labels for loose produce and bags of the same vegetables.
examples.zh: 这家店把「散装蔬果」和同款袋装蔬菜分开贴标签。

words.enDefinition: Fruit and vegetables packaged before being displayed for sale

examples.en: I checked both labels because the prepacked produce came from two different farms.
examples.zh: 因为这两份「预包装蔬果」来自不同农场，我查看了两张标签。

examples.en: My flatmate looked through the prepacked produce and found a small bag of carrots.
examples.zh: 室友看了看「预包装蔬果」，找到一小袋胡萝卜。

words.enDefinition: Fruit sold already cut into pieces

examples.en: I picked up pre-cut fruit for the group meeting because there were no knives.
examples.zh: 小组会上没有刀，我买了「预切水果」带去。

examples.en: The shop puts the pre-cut fruit in a chilled display next to the salad.
examples.zh: 店里把「预切水果」放在沙拉旁的冷藏柜里。

words.enDefinition: Fruit and vegetables available around their usual harvest time

examples.en: The market puts seasonal produce near the entrance so shoppers can see what just arrived.
examples.zh: 市场把「应季蔬果」摆在入口附近，让顾客能看见刚到的货。

examples.en: I asked which seasonal produce would still be on the stall in late May.
examples.zh: 我问到了五月底，摊位上还会有哪些「应季蔬果」。

words.enDefinition: Grown within the surrounding area

examples.en: I asked which apples were locally grown before choosing some for my flatmates.
examples.zh: 给室友挑苹果前，我先问了哪些是「本地种植的」。

examples.en: The label said the pears were locally grown and named the farm that supplied them.
examples.zh: 标签写明梨是「本地种植的」，还列了供货农场的名字。

words.enDefinition: Fruit and vegetables brought in from another country

examples.en: The signs show which fruit comes from nearby farms and which is imported produce.
examples.zh: 标签标出了哪些水果来自附近农场，哪些是「进口蔬果」。

examples.en: I compared the labels on the imported produce before choosing a bag of grapes.
examples.zh: 选一袋葡萄之前，我对照看了「进口蔬果」的标签。

words.enDefinition: At the usual time of harvest and availability

examples.en: The stallholder said the figs were in season and would come in again on Friday.
examples.zh: 摊主说，无花果「正当季」，周五还会再到货。

examples.en: I asked whether asparagus was in season when I saw it near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我在入口附近看到芦笋，就问现在是不是「正当季」。

words.enDefinition: Fruit and vegetables grown under organic production standards

examples.en: The shop labels its organic produce on a separate shelf near the entrance.
examples.zh: 这家店把「有机蔬果」标示在入口附近单独的货架上。

examples.en: I checked the label because the organic produce looked similar to the other vegetables.
examples.zh: 「有机蔬果」看着和其他蔬菜差不多，所以我看了一下标签。

words.enDefinition: Grown using methods outside organic production standards

examples.en: The shop had two kinds of strawberries, and this pack was labelled conventionally grown.
examples.zh: 店里有两种草莓，这盒标的是「采用常规方式种植的」。

examples.en: I asked which apples were conventionally grown because the signs were hard to read.
examples.zh: 标签不太好辨认，我就问哪些苹果是「采用常规方式种植的」。

words.enDefinition: Salad leaves washed before being packaged for sale

examples.en: The fridge by the entrance has prewashed salad in small bags near the herbs.
examples.zh: 入口旁的冷柜里有小袋「预洗沙拉菜」，摆在香草旁。

examples.en: I checked whether the prewashed salad contained any of the leaves my roommate wanted.
examples.zh: 我看了看「预洗沙拉菜」里有没有室友想要的那几种叶菜。

words.enDefinition: Salad leaves sold together in a bag

examples.en: I picked up a bagged salad to share with my flatmates after our lecture.
examples.zh: 我买了一份「袋装沙拉菜」，准备下课后和室友一起吃。

examples.en: The bagged salad is on the top shelf of the refrigerated display near the entrance.
examples.zh: 「袋装沙拉菜」在入口附近冷藏展示柜的最上层。

words.enDefinition: Fruit and vegetables with unusual shapes

examples.en: The stall sells misshapen produce in a separate crate next to the potatoes.
examples.zh: 摊位把「形状不规则的蔬果」放在土豆旁的一个单独的箱子里卖。

examples.en: I found carrots and pears in the box marked misshapen produce on the counter.
examples.zh: 我在柜台上标着「形状不规则的蔬果」的箱子里找到了胡萝卜和梨。

words.enDefinition: A small bag for loose fruits or vegetables

examples.en: I reached for a produce bag before picking out three apples and a lemon.
examples.zh: 我先拿了一个「蔬果袋」，才挑了三个苹果和一个柠檬。

examples.en: I pulled a produce bag off the roll next to the self-service scale.
examples.zh: 我从自助秤旁的那卷袋子上撕下一个「蔬果袋」。

words.enDefinition: A small label stuck directly onto fresh produce

examples.en: I checked the produce sticker on the pear to see what variety it was.
examples.zh: 我看了一下梨上的「蔬果贴纸」，想知道是什么品种。

examples.en: The produce sticker came off when I took the apple out of my bag.
examples.zh: 我从袋子里拿出苹果时，「蔬果贴纸」脱落了。

collocations: a code on the produce sticker

words.enDefinition: A code identifying loose produce at checkout

examples.en: The cashier entered the PLU code from the sticker to look up the variety of apple I'd chosen.
examples.zh: 收银员输入贴纸上的「价格查询编码」，查找我挑的苹果品种。

examples.en: I couldn't find the PLU code on the loose pears when I reached the checkout.
examples.zh: 到收银台时，我没在散装梨上找到「价格查询编码」。

words.enDefinition: The country where a product comes from

examples.en: The country of origin was printed in small letters below the name of the fruit.
examples.zh: 水果名称下方用小字标出了「原产国」。

examples.en: I checked the country of origin on both packs because they looked almost identical.
examples.zh: 这两份看上去几乎一模一样，所以我看了看两个包装上的「原产国」。

words.enDefinition: Priced for each separate item

examples.en: The small melons were sold individually, so I could take just one for the picnic.
examples.zh: 小瓜是「按个出售」的，我只买一个带去野餐就行。

examples.en: I asked whether the apples were sold individually or if I needed the whole bag.
examples.zh: 我问苹果是「按个出售」，还是得买一整袋。

words.enDefinition: Priced for a group of items tied together

examples.en: The spring onions were sold by the bunch at the stall near campus.
examples.zh: 学校附近的摊位上，青葱是「按把出售」的。

examples.en: I asked which herbs were sold by the bunch instead of in plastic packets.
examples.zh: 我问哪些香草是「按把出售」的，而不是用塑料袋预先包好的。

collocations: sold by the bunch at the market
sold by the bunch or by weight

words.enDefinition: A scale shoppers operate to weigh their purchases

examples.en: I took my apples to the self-service scale beside the shelf of reusable bags.
examples.zh: 我把苹果拿到可重复使用的袋子货架旁的「自助秤」上。

examples.en: The self-service scale showed a picture of the fruit before I chose the label.
examples.zh: 我选择标签前，「自助秤」显示了水果的图片。

collocations: weigh fruit on a self-service scale
a self-service scale in the produce section

words.enDefinition: The weight of a container without its contents

examples.en: The scale screen showed the tare weight after I selected my reusable produce bag.
examples.zh: 我选了可重复使用的蔬果袋后，秤屏上显示了「包装皮重」。

examples.en: I asked whether the tare weight was already deducted when I weighed my vegetables.
examples.zh: 称蔬菜时，我问「包装皮重」是不是已经扣除了。

words.enDefinition: The weight of an item excluding its packaging

examples.en: The sticker gave the net weight of the berries below the name of the farm.
examples.zh: 贴纸在农场名称下方写了这盒莓果的「净重」。

examples.en: I checked the net weight because the two bags looked almost the same size.
examples.zh: 两个袋子看起来差不多大，我就看了看「净重」。

collocations: the net weight on the label

words.enDefinition: To print a sticker showing the measured weight

examples.en: The scale asked me to print a weight label after selecting the right variety.
examples.zh: 选对品种后，秤提示我「打印称重标签」。

examples.en: I went back to print a weight label because the first sticker tore.
examples.zh: 第一张贴纸撕破了，所以我回去重新「打印称重标签」。

collocations: prompt someone to print a weight label
print a weight label at the scale
print a weight label for loose produce

words.enDefinition: To read the barcode on a produce sticker electronically

examples.en: I couldn't scan the produce label because I'd stuck it across a fold.
examples.zh: 我贴标签时跨过了一个折痕，结果没法「扫描蔬果标签」。

examples.en: The cashier asked me to scan the produce label at the self-service checkout.
examples.zh: 收银员让我在自助结账机上「扫描蔬果标签」。

collocations: try to scan the produce label
scan the produce label at checkout
ask someone to scan the produce label

words.enDefinition: To measure the weight of fruit or vegetables being bought

examples.en: Do you have to weigh your produce in this aisle or at the checkout?
examples.zh: 你得在这条货架通道里「给买的蔬果称重」，还是去收银台称？

examples.en: The sign says you can weigh your produce next to the loose apples.
examples.zh: 告示说，可以在散装苹果旁边「给买的蔬果称重」。

collocations: weigh your produce at the scale

words.enDefinition: Showing the cost for each kilogram

examples.en: The potatoes were priced per kilo, so I checked the weight before choosing a bag.
examples.zh: 土豆是「按千克标价」的，我选袋子前先看了重量。

examples.en: I asked whether the loose pears were priced per kilo like the apples.
examples.zh: 我问散装梨是不是跟苹果一样「按千克标价」。

words.enDefinition: A small container used for fruit or vegetables

examples.en: I bought a punnet of raspberries at the market beside my college in England.
examples.zh: 我在英格兰学校旁的市场买了「一小盒」覆盆子。

examples.en: The greengrocer put another punnet of cherry tomatoes beside the bunches of basil.
examples.zh: 蔬果店店员在成把的罗勒旁又摆了「一小盒」小番茄。

words.enDefinition: A hinged container with a top and bottom

examples.en: The blueberries came in a clamshell container that opened from the long side.
examples.zh: 蓝莓装在一个可以从长边打开的「翻盖盒」里。

examples.en: I checked the bottom of the clamshell container before choosing which berries to buy.
examples.zh: 挑莓果前，我先看了看「翻盖盒」的底部。

words.enDefinition: Several bananas still joined at the stem

examples.en: I bought a small bunch of bananas on my way back from class.
examples.zh: 我下课回家路上买了「一小串香蕉」。

examples.en: My roommate asked me to choose a bunch of bananas with some green left.
examples.zh: 室友让我选「一串还带点绿色的香蕉」。

words.enDefinition: A whole lettuce with its leaves still attached

examples.en: I bought a head of lettuce because four people were coming to dinner.
examples.zh: 有四个人要来吃晚饭，所以我买了「一整棵生菜」。

examples.en: The stallholder handed me a head of lettuce with bright green outer leaves.
examples.zh: 摊主递给我「一整棵生菜」，外层叶子是鲜绿色的。

words.enDefinition: A person who sells fresh fruit and vegetables

examples.en: The greengrocer near my university helped me pick pears that were ready to eat.
examples.zh: 学校附近的「蔬果商」帮我挑了能直接吃的梨。

examples.en: I asked the greengrocer when the next delivery of fresh herbs would arrive.
examples.zh: 我问「蔬果商」下一批新鲜香草什么时候到货。

words.enDefinition: A stall selling produce directly from a farm

examples.en: The farm stand near campus had peaches from the farm's own trees that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，学校附近的「农场直销摊」有农场自家树上结的桃子。

examples.en: We bought two corn cobs at the farm stand on our way back from town.
examples.zh: 我们从镇上回来的路上，在「农场直销摊」买了两根玉米。

words.enDefinition: Fully developed and ready to eat

examples.en: The market seller pointed out which peaches were ripe enough to eat that evening.
examples.zh: 摊主指出哪些桃子已经「成熟」，当天晚上就能吃。

examples.en: I picked one ripe pear for lunch and another to keep until Friday.
examples.zh: 我挑了一个「成熟的」梨午餐吃，另一个留到周五。

words.enDefinition: Not yet fully developed or ready to eat

examples.en: The unripe bananas were still green when I brought them home from the shop.
examples.zh: 我从店里带回来的「未成熟的」香蕉还是青的。

examples.en: The stallholder showed me which mangoes were unripe and which I could eat that evening.
examples.zh: 摊主告诉我哪些芒果「还没成熟」，哪些当晚就能吃。

words.enDefinition: Past the stage of being fully ripe

examples.en: I chose the firmer pears because the softer ones already looked overripe to me.
examples.zh: 我挑了硬一点的梨，因为软的那些看起来已经「熟过头了」。

examples.en: The shop put overripe bananas in a separate box by the produce display.
examples.zh: 店家把「熟过头的」香蕉另外放进生鲜货架旁的箱子里。

words.enDefinition: To become ready to eat as fruit develops

examples.en: The stallholder said these pears would ripen by the time my flatmates came back.
examples.zh: 摊主说，等我室友回来，这些梨就会「成熟」。

examples.en: I chose two mangoes at different stages so they wouldn't both ripen on the same day.
examples.zh: 我挑了两个成熟程度不同的芒果，这样它们就不会在同一天「成熟」。

words.enDefinition: Not soft when lightly pressed

examples.en: I chose a peach that was still firm to the touch for the weekend.
examples.zh: 我挑了一个「摸起来还比较硬的」桃子，打算周末吃。

examples.en: The cucumbers looked similar, so I picked one that was firm to the touch.
examples.zh: 黄瓜看起来都差不多，我就挑了一根「摸起来硬实的」。

collocations: choose fruit that's firm to the touch

words.enDefinition: To yield a little under gentle pressure

examples.en: The pears near the front give slightly when pressed, unlike the ones behind them.
examples.zh: 靠前的梨「轻按时微微下陷」，后面的那些则不同。

examples.en: I asked whether the mango should give slightly or feel completely firm today.
examples.zh: 我问这个芒果今天应该「轻按时微微下陷」，还是摸起来很硬。

words.enDefinition: A small area that feels softer than the rest

examples.en: I noticed a soft spot on one side of the pear at the market.
examples.zh: 我在市场发现这个梨的一侧「有一小块发软」。

examples.en: I checked the mango for a soft spot before putting it in my bag.
examples.zh: 我把芒果放进袋子前看了看有没有「一小块发软的地方」。

collocations: a soft spot on a pear

words.enDefinition: Marked or damaged by being bumped or pressed

examples.en: I put back the bruised apple and chose one from the other side.
examples.zh: 我放回那个「碰伤的」苹果，从另一边选了一个。

examples.en: Several peaches were bruised on the side where they touched the wooden box.
examples.zh: 有几个桃子在碰着木箱的一侧「有碰伤」。

words.enDefinition: Leaves that have lost their firmness and freshness

examples.en: I left the bunch with wilted leaves and chose the one next to it.
examples.zh: 我没拿那把「叶子打蔫的」，选了旁边的一把。

examples.en: Some of the wilted leaves were hidden at the bottom of the salad bag.
examples.zh: 有几片「打蔫的叶子」藏在袋装沙拉菜的底部。

words.enDefinition: A round fruit with firm flesh and thin skin

examples.en: I put an apple in my bag to eat after the afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 我把一个「苹果」放进包里，准备下午的讲座结束后吃。

examples.en: The shop had three kinds of apple on the shelf near the door.
examples.zh: 店门旁的货架上摆了三种「苹果」。

words.enDefinition: A long curved fruit with soft flesh

examples.en: I bought a banana to eat on the bus after my morning class.
examples.zh: 我买了一根「香蕉」，打算上完早课在公交车上吃。

examples.en: The bananas by the window were greener than the ones near the checkout.
examples.zh: 窗边的「香蕉」比收银台旁的还要青一些。

words.enDefinition: A fruit usually wider at the bottom

examples.en: I chose a pear that felt firm enough to carry in my backpack.
examples.zh: 我挑了一个摸着够硬的「梨」，方便放在背包里带走。

examples.en: The pears from that stall stayed firm for a few days in our flat.
examples.zh: 从那个摊位买的「梨」放在我们公寓里，好几天都是硬的。

words.enDefinition: A soft red fruit with seeds on its surface

examples.en: I bought strawberries on my walk home from the library for our weekend picnic.
examples.zh: 我从图书馆走回家时买了些「草莓」，准备周末野餐吃。

examples.en: Only one strawberry in the whole box still had a pale tip on it.
examples.zh: 一整盒里只有一颗「草莓」的尖端还发白。

words.enDefinition: A small round fruit with blue-purple skin

examples.en: The shop had two sizes of blueberries in the chilled display beside the grapes.
examples.zh: 葡萄旁的冷藏柜里有两种规格的「蓝莓」。

examples.en: One blueberry had rolled out of the box and into my shopping bag.
examples.zh: 有一颗「蓝莓」从盒子里滚到了我的购物袋里。

words.enDefinition: A small soft berry made of many tiny parts

examples.en: The raspberries were in shallow boxes so I could see almost every berry clearly.
examples.zh: 「覆盆子」装在浅盒里，我几乎能看清每一颗。

examples.en: I found a raspberry stuck to the lid when I opened the container.
examples.zh: 我打开盒子时，发现一颗「覆盆子」粘在盖子上。

words.enDefinition: A dark soft berry made of many tiny parts

examples.en: The blackberries looked dark and glossy in the market stall's smallest boxes that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，摊位小盒里的「黑莓」乌黑发亮。

examples.en: I chose blackberries instead of a bag of apples for the group picnic.
examples.zh: 我给小组野餐买了「黑莓」，没买那袋苹果。

words.enDefinition: A combination of several kinds of berries

examples.en: The mixed berries in the chilled case included blueberries and two kinds of red berries.
examples.zh: 冷藏柜里的「混合莓果」包括蓝莓和两种红色莓果。

examples.en: I bought a small pack of mixed berries to share after our last lecture.
examples.zh: 我买了一小盒「混合莓果」，准备最后一节课结束后和大家一起吃。

words.enDefinition: Fruit such as oranges, lemons, and grapefruits

examples.en: The citrus fruit was stacked beside the apples, with a sign for each variety.
examples.zh: 「柑橘类水果」堆在苹果旁边，每个品种都标了牌子。

examples.en: I asked where to find citrus fruit because I needed both lemons and oranges.
examples.zh: 我问「柑橘类水果」在哪儿，因为我既要买柠檬，也要买橙子。

words.enDefinition: Fruit containing a single large hard stone

examples.en: The fruit stand put peaches and plums under a sign that said stone fruit.
examples.zh: 水果摊把桃子和李子摆在写着「核果」的牌子下。

examples.en: I asked which stone fruit would still be in stock for next week's picnic.
examples.zh: 我问给下周野餐买水果时，还能买到哪些「核果」。

words.enDefinition: A sweet orange with a navel-like mark at one end

examples.en: I picked a navel orange from the display near the shop's front door.
examples.zh: 我从店门口附近的展台上挑了一个「脐橙」。

examples.en: The sign showed a navel orange cut in half beside the fruit's variety name.
examples.zh: 标签在水果品种名称旁放了一张切开一半的「脐橙」图片。

words.enDefinition: An orange with red or reddish flesh

examples.en: The sign showed what a blood orange looked like after it was cut open.
examples.zh: 标签上展示了「血橙」切开后的样子。

examples.en: I bought a blood orange because my flatmate wanted to try the red variety.
examples.zh: 室友想尝尝红色果肉的品种，我就买了一个「血橙」。

words.enDefinition: A small round citrus fruit with loose skin

examples.en: I bought a mandarin orange for my bag because it's easy to peel.
examples.zh: 我买了一个「橘子」放在包里，因为它好剥皮。

examples.en: My roommate put a mandarin orange and some grapes on each lunch tray.
examples.zh: 室友在每个午餐盘里放了一个「橘子」和几颗葡萄。

words.enDefinition: A large citrus fruit with tart, sometimes bitter flesh

examples.en: The shop sells grapefruit individually near the oranges and lemons.
examples.zh: 店里「葡萄柚」按个卖，就在橙子和柠檬旁边。

examples.en: I picked a grapefruit from the display with the pink flesh shown on its sign.
examples.zh: 我从标签上画着粉色果肉的展台上挑了一个「葡萄柚」。

words.enDefinition: A very large citrus fruit with a thick rind

examples.en: I found a pomelo in a net bag beside the rest of the citrus fruit.
examples.zh: 我在其他柑橘类水果旁找到一个装在网袋里的「柚子」。

examples.en: The stallholder held up a pomelo so I could see how big it was.
examples.zh: 摊主举起一个「柚子」，让我看看它有多大。

words.enDefinition: A yellow citrus fruit with sour juice

examples.en: I bought a lemon because the ones at home had already been used.
examples.zh: 家里的都用完了，我又买了一个「柠檬」。

examples.en: The lemon I picked had smooth yellow skin and felt heavy for its size.
examples.zh: 我挑的「柠檬」果皮又黄又光滑，个头不大但拿着挺沉。

words.enDefinition: A small citrus fruit with sour juice and typically green skin

examples.en: The limes were next to the lemons in a separate crate by the door.
examples.zh: 「青柠」就在柠檬旁边，摆在门边一个单独的箱子里。

examples.en: I asked whether I could buy one lime instead of taking the whole bag.
examples.zh: 我问能不能只买一个「青柠」，不用买整袋。

words.enDefinition: Grapes without hard mature seeds

examples.en: I picked up seedless grapes before heading to the library with my flatmates.
examples.zh: 和室友去图书馆之前，我买了点「无籽葡萄」。

examples.en: The sign said both colours were seedless grapes, so I chose the darker ones.
examples.zh: 标签写着两种颜色的都是「无籽葡萄」，所以我选了颜色深的。

words.enDefinition: A large sweet fruit with rough skin and yellow flesh

examples.en: I carried the pineapple home separately because it didn't fit in my small bag.
examples.zh: 这个「菠萝」塞不进我的小袋子，我就单独拎回去了。

examples.en: The fruit stall had a pineapple cut open to show the colour inside.
examples.zh: 水果摊切开了一个「菠萝」，让顾客看里面是什么颜色。

words.enDefinition: A sweet tropical fruit with one large flat stone

examples.en: I chose a mango from the smaller crate for our picnic on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我从小一点的箱子里挑了一个「芒果」，准备周六野餐吃。

examples.en: The sticker on this mango showed its variety and the country where it grew.
examples.zh: 这个「芒果」的贴纸上写了品种和种植国。

words.enDefinition: A tropical fruit with soft flesh and many black seeds

examples.en: I picked a small papaya because I didn't need enough for the whole flat.
examples.zh: 我挑了一个小「番木瓜」，因为不用买够所有室友吃的量。

examples.en: The shop had half a papaya in a tray next to the whole ones.
examples.zh: 店里的半个「番木瓜」装在托盘里，就摆在整果旁边。

words.enDefinition: A fruit with creamy flesh and one large seed

examples.en: I bought an avocado to take with my lunch after the morning seminar.
examples.zh: 我买了一个「牛油果」，准备上午的研讨课结束后配午饭吃。

examples.en: My roommate wanted an avocado for that evening, so I chose a softer one.
examples.zh: 室友想当晚吃「牛油果」，所以我挑了一个软一点的。

words.enDefinition: A round fruit filled with juicy seeds

examples.en: I chose a pomegranate after the seller showed me one that had been opened.
examples.zh: 摊主给我看了一个掰开的「石榴」后，我也挑了一个。

examples.en: The pomegranate was on the same shelf as the mangoes, just below the sign.
examples.zh: 「石榴」和芒果在同一层货架上，就在标签下方。

words.enDefinition: An orange fruit that may be firm or soft when ripe

examples.en: I asked whether the persimmon was a variety people eat while still firm.
examples.zh: 我问这种「柿子」是不是可以趁还硬的时候吃。

examples.en: The persimmon had a green leafy cap and an orange skin with no marks.
examples.zh: 这个「柿子」有绿色的叶状蒂，橙色外皮上一点伤痕也没有。

words.enDefinition: A soft sweet fruit with many tiny seeds

examples.en: I bought a fig from the stall after the seller offered me a sample.
examples.zh: 摊主让我试吃以后，我在摊位上买了一个「无花果」。

examples.en: This fig looked softer than the others, so I kept it on top.
examples.zh: 这个「无花果」看起来比其他的软，所以我把它放在最上面。

words.enDefinition: A small fruit with brown skin and seed-filled flesh

examples.en: The kiwifruit near the bananas had a label showing green flesh inside.
examples.zh: 香蕉旁边的「猕猴桃」有个标签，图上画的是绿色果肉。

examples.en: I put three kiwifruit in the basket to share with my flatmates after dinner.
examples.zh: 我往篮子里放了三个「猕猴桃」，打算晚饭后和室友分着吃。

words.enDefinition: A tropical fruit with aromatic pulp and many seeds

examples.en: The label showed what a passion fruit looks like with the skin opened.
examples.zh: 标签上展示了「百香果」剖开果皮后的样子。

examples.en: I found passion fruit next to the figs when I visited the market on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六去市场时，我在无花果旁找到了「百香果」。

words.enDefinition: A cactus fruit with bright skin and speckled flesh

examples.en: I asked whether this dragon fruit had white or red flesh inside.
examples.zh: 我问这个「火龙果」里面是白色果肉还是红色果肉。

examples.en: A dragon fruit was displayed with its cut side facing up so we could see it.
examples.zh: 一个「火龙果」切面朝上摆着，方便我们看里面。

words.enDefinition: A tropical fruit with fragrant flesh and many seeds

examples.en: The sign said the guava in this box had pink flesh rather than white.
examples.zh: 标签写着这盒「番石榴」是粉色果肉的，不是白色的。

examples.en: I picked a guava while my roommate was choosing a bag of green grapes.
examples.zh: 室友在选一袋青葡萄时，我挑了一个「番石榴」。

words.enDefinition: A small fruit with rough skin and translucent flesh

examples.en: The shop had a picture showing how much flesh was inside one lychee.
examples.zh: 店里有张图片，展示了一颗「荔枝」里面有多少果肉。

examples.en: I chose lychees from the market stall to share during our afternoon break.
examples.zh: 我在市场摊位上挑了些「荔枝」，准备下午休息时和大家分享。

words.enDefinition: A melon usually with orange flesh and a netted rind

examples.en: The cantaloupe had a rough skin, unlike the smooth melon beside it.
examples.zh: 这个「橙肉甜瓜」的皮是粗糙的，旁边那个瓜的皮却很光滑。

examples.en: I bought half a cantaloupe because a whole one wouldn't fit in our fridge.
examples.zh: 我买了半个「橙肉甜瓜」，因为整个放不进我们的冰箱。

words.enDefinition: A smooth-skinned melon usually with pale green flesh

examples.en: A picture on the sign showed the pale green inside of a honeydew melon.
examples.zh: 标签上的图片展示了「蜜露甜瓜」浅绿色的果肉。

examples.en: The cashier asked whether the melon in my basket was a honeydew melon.
examples.zh: 收银员问我篮子里的瓜是不是「蜜露甜瓜」。

words.enDefinition: A large melon with juicy flesh and a green rind

examples.en: I bought half a watermelon because I was taking the bus back to campus.
examples.zh: 我要坐公交回学校，所以只买了半个「西瓜」。

examples.en: The shop showed the inside of a seedless watermelon on the sign by the crate.
examples.zh: 瓜箱旁的标签上画了切开的无籽「西瓜」。

words.enDefinition: A soft stone fruit with fuzzy skin

examples.en: The peach I chose had a reddish patch but no marks from handling.
examples.zh: 我挑的「桃子」有一块皮是淡红色的，但没有磕碰的痕迹。

examples.en: I bought another peach after my flatmate said she wanted one for lunch.
examples.zh: 室友说午餐想吃一个「桃子」，我就多买了一个。

words.enDefinition: A variety of peach with smooth skin

examples.en: The nectarine looked like a peach but had smooth skin instead of fuzz.
examples.zh: 「油桃」看着像桃子，但皮很光滑，没有绒毛。

examples.en: I bought a nectarine for the afternoon because the peaches still felt hard.
examples.zh: 桃子摸着还硬，我就买了一个「油桃」下午吃。

words.enDefinition: A soft stone fruit with smooth skin

examples.en: I chose a purple plum and a yellow one from the same stall.
examples.zh: 我在同一个摊位上选了一个紫色「李子」和一个黄色的。

examples.en: The plum at the bottom of my bag had a small bruise.
examples.zh: 我袋子底部的「李子」有一小块碰伤。

words.enDefinition: A small stone fruit with yellow-orange skin

examples.en: I found a fresh apricot in the box marked with the farm's name.
examples.zh: 我在标有农场名称的箱子里找到一个新鲜的「杏」。

examples.en: The stallholder said each apricot in the small tray was from the same orchard.
examples.zh: 摊主说，小托盘里的每个「杏」都来自同一个果园。

words.enDefinition: A small round fruit with a hard stone

examples.en: One cherry had lost its stem, but the rest still looked fresh to me.
examples.zh: 有一颗「樱桃」的果梗掉了，其他的在我看来还是新鲜的。

examples.en: I bought cherries on the way to our study group as a snack to share.
examples.zh: 去参加学习小组的路上，我买了些「樱桃」当零食，准备分给大家。

words.enDefinition: A starchy banana usually eaten after cooking

examples.en: I asked which plantain was ripe enough for the dish my roommate had planned.
examples.zh: 室友想做道菜，我问哪个「烹调用香蕉」熟得差不多了。

examples.en: The plantain was in a separate display from the smaller bananas near the register.
examples.zh: 「烹调用香蕉」和收银台附近的小香蕉分开展示。

words.enDefinition: A crisp, juicy pear often shaped like an apple

examples.en: The shop displayed an Asian pear beside an apple to show how similar they look.
examples.zh: 店里把一个「亚洲梨」摆在苹果旁边，展示它们有多相像。

examples.en: The sign described the Asian pear as crisp and showed its round shape.
examples.zh: 标签说「亚洲梨」口感脆，还展示了它圆圆的形状。

words.enDefinition: A small juicy fruit that grows in clusters

examples.en: I bought grapes to share at our study group in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 我买了点「葡萄」，准备下午和学习小组的人分着吃。

examples.en: One grape had fallen from the bunch and rolled under the market stall.
examples.zh: 有一颗「葡萄」从那串上掉了下来，滚到了摊位下面。

words.enDefinition: A small red fruit with a tart flavour

examples.en: One cranberry rolled out when I opened the bag to check the berries.
examples.zh: 我打开袋子查看莓果时，一颗「蔓越莓」滚了出来。

examples.en: I found fresh cranberries on the lower shelf beside the apples at the market.
examples.zh: 我在市场里苹果旁边的下层货架上找到了新鲜的「蔓越莓」。

words.enDefinition: Vegetables grown mainly for their edible green leaves

examples.en: I looked for leafy greens that would fit in our small shared fridge.
examples.zh: 我找了些放得进我们共用小冰箱的「绿叶蔬菜」。

examples.en: The stallholder moved the leafy greens into the shade when the market opened.
examples.zh: 市场开门时，摊主把「绿叶蔬菜」搬到了阴凉处。

words.enDefinition: Vegetables such as carrots grown for their roots

examples.en: The stall grouped root vegetables together with carrots in one crate and beets in another.
examples.zh: 摊位把「根菜类蔬菜」摆在一起，胡萝卜和甜菜根分别放在不同的箱子里。

examples.en: I bought a mix of root vegetables for dinner with my flatmates that evening.
examples.zh: 我买了几种「根菜类蔬菜」，准备那天晚上和室友一起吃。

words.enDefinition: A round lettuce with tightly packed crisp leaves

examples.en: I picked up iceberg lettuce because it was sold in smaller heads that day.
examples.zh: 那天「脆球生菜」有比较小的整棵卖，所以我买了一棵。

examples.en: The iceberg lettuce was next to the bags of salad in the chilled display.
examples.zh: 冷藏柜里的「脆球生菜」就在袋装沙拉菜旁边。

words.enDefinition: Lettuce with long leaves and firm central ribs

examples.en: The romaine lettuce had longer leaves than the other kind on the same shelf.
examples.zh: 同一层货架上，「罗马生菜」的叶子比另一种生菜更长。

examples.en: I asked whether the romaine lettuce was sold by the head or in bags.
examples.zh: 我问「罗马生菜」是按整棵卖，还是袋装卖。

words.enDefinition: A leafy green with a noticeably peppery taste

examples.en: I found arugula in small bags beside the spinach at the campus supermarket.
examples.zh: 我在学校附近超市的菠菜旁找到了小袋装的「芝麻菜」。

examples.en: My flatmate asked for arugula because she wanted a more peppery salad.
examples.zh: 室友想让沙拉多一点辛辣味，就让我买「芝麻菜」。

words.enDefinition: A leafy vegetable with soft dark green leaves

examples.en: I bought spinach on the way home because my flatmate needed some for dinner.
examples.zh: 回家路上我买了「菠菜」，因为室友做晚饭要用。

examples.en: The spinach came in a small bag that fit in our crowded shared fridge.
examples.zh: 「菠菜」是小袋装的，能放进我们塞得满满的共用冰箱。

words.enDefinition: A cabbage relative with loose, often curly leaves

examples.en: The market sold kale in bunches beside the crates of other leafy vegetables.
examples.zh: 市场把「羽衣甘蓝」按把出售，摆在其他叶菜的箱子旁边。

examples.en: I chose the kale with smaller leaves because I was buying for just myself.
examples.zh: 我只买自己吃的量，就选了叶子小一点的「羽衣甘蓝」。

words.enDefinition: A leafy vegetable with broad leaves and colourful stalks

examples.en: The Swiss chard at the stall had bright red stalks and wide green leaves.
examples.zh: 摊位上的「叶用甜菜」有鲜红色的叶柄和宽大的绿叶。

examples.en: I asked the seller whether the Swiss chard was sold loose or by the bunch.
examples.zh: 我问摊主，「叶用甜菜」是散卖还是按把卖。

words.enDefinition: A small leafy green with a peppery taste

examples.en: I found a bag of watercress near the fresh herbs in the refrigerated section.
examples.zh: 我在冷藏区的新鲜香草旁找到了一袋「西洋菜」。

examples.en: The sign said watercress, so I checked my list before taking the bag.
examples.zh: 标签上写的是「西洋菜」，我对照购物清单后才拿了那一袋。

words.enDefinition: A leafy cabbage with green leaves and pale stalks

examples.en: I bought bok choy on my way home from our evening group meeting.
examples.zh: 晚上小组会议结束后，我在回家路上买了「小白菜」。

examples.en: The box of bok choy was just below the shelf with the loose carrots.
examples.zh: 装「小白菜」的箱子就在散装胡萝卜货架下面。

words.enDefinition: An elongated cabbage with tightly packed pale leaves

examples.en: I chose a small napa cabbage that would fit in our shared vegetable drawer.
examples.zh: 我挑了棵小一点的「大白菜」，能放进我们共用的蔬菜抽屉。

examples.en: The sign for napa cabbage showed a picture of its pale inner leaves.
examples.zh: 「大白菜」的标签上印着一张照片，展示它浅色的内叶。

words.enDefinition: A leafy vegetable usually forming a dense round head

examples.en: I bought half a cabbage because a whole head was too much for me.
examples.zh: 一整棵太多，我就买了半棵「卷心菜」。

examples.en: The cabbage in the lower crate had tighter leaves than the one on display.
examples.zh: 下面箱子里的「卷心菜」比展台上的那棵叶片更紧实。

words.enDefinition: A vegetable with clusters of green flower buds

examples.en: The broccoli was on a low shelf beside the crates of cauliflower.
examples.zh: 「西兰花」在一个矮货架上，旁边是装菜花的箱子。

examples.en: I chose the broccoli with a smaller head because I had limited space.
examples.zh: 因为地方有限，我挑了棵花球小一点的「西兰花」。

words.enDefinition: A vegetable with a dense head of flower buds

examples.en: I bought a small cauliflower because our fridge already had plenty of vegetables.
examples.zh: 我们冰箱里已经有不少蔬菜了，我就买了棵小「菜花」。

examples.en: The cauliflower was wrapped in its outer leaves when the seller handed it over.
examples.zh: 摊主递过来时，「菜花」还裹着它外层的叶子。

words.enDefinition: Small green buds that look like tiny cabbages

examples.en: The shop sold Brussels sprouts loose and left a small basket beside the scale.
examples.zh: 店里散卖「抱子甘蓝」，秤旁还放了个小筐。

examples.en: I picked up Brussels sprouts for my flatmate while we shopped for weekend dinner.
examples.zh: 给周末晚饭买菜时，我帮室友拿了些「抱子甘蓝」。

words.enDefinition: Long tender shoots sold as a vegetable

examples.en: I found asparagus in small bundles beside the green beans at the market.
examples.zh: 我在市场的四季豆旁找到了一小把一小把的「芦笋」。

examples.en: The asparagus at that stall came from a farm a few miles away.
examples.zh: 那个摊位的「芦笋」来自几英里外的一家农场。

words.enDefinition: A knobbly underground stem with a spicy flavour

examples.en: I bought a small piece of ginger from the loose produce bin by the door.
examples.zh: 我从门边的散装蔬果箱里买了一小块「姜」。

examples.en: The ginger was next to the garlic rather than with the other root vegetables.
examples.zh: 「姜」在大蒜旁边，没和其他根菜放在一起。

words.enDefinition: A vegetable with long, crisp, edible stalks

examples.en: I bought celery from a stall just outside the station on my way home.
examples.zh: 我回家路上在车站外的摊位买了「芹菜」。

examples.en: The celery was tied in large bunches, so I shared one with my roommate.
examples.zh: 「芹菜」扎成了大把，我就和室友分了一把。

words.enDefinition: A root vegetable that is commonly orange

examples.en: I added one carrot to the bag after checking how much I needed.
examples.zh: 确认需要多少之后，我往袋子里加了一根「胡萝卜」。

examples.en: The carrots with green tops were on the top shelf beside the onions.
examples.zh: 带着绿叶的「胡萝卜」放在最上层，就在洋葱旁边。

words.enDefinition: An edible beet root usually deep red in colour

examples.en: I asked whether the beetroot on display was sold loose or by the bunch.
examples.zh: 我问摆出来的「甜菜根」是散卖还是成把卖。

examples.en: I chose three small beetroots from the box near the market stall's wooden scale.
examples.zh: 我从摊位木秤边的箱子里挑了三个小「甜菜根」。

words.enDefinition: A pale, sweet root vegetable shaped like a carrot

examples.en: I picked up a parsnip because the label said it had a sweet flavour.
examples.zh: 我拿了一根「欧防风根」，因为标签说它味道偏甜。

examples.en: The parsnip had been placed in the same crate as the larger carrots.
examples.zh: 那根「欧防风根」和较大的胡萝卜放在同一个箱子里。

words.enDefinition: A large, typically white radish from East Asia

examples.en: I found a daikon beside the Napa cabbage in the international grocery shop.
examples.zh: 我在国际食品杂货店的大白菜旁找到了一根「白萝卜」。

examples.en: The daikon was longer than my shopping bag, so I carried it separately.
examples.zh: 那根「白萝卜」比我的购物袋还长，我就另外拎着。

words.enDefinition: A sweet starchy root sold as a vegetable

examples.en: I bought a sweet potato because the shop was selling them individually that day.
examples.zh: 那天店里「红薯」可以按个买，我就买了一个。

examples.en: The sweet potato in my bag was smaller than the ones in the display.
examples.zh: 我袋子里的「红薯」比展台上的那些小一点。

words.enDefinition: A small bulb with a mild onion flavour

examples.en: I picked a shallot from the small basket between the onions and the garlic.
examples.zh: 我在洋葱和大蒜中间的小篮里挑了一个「红葱头」。

examples.en: The cashier checked whether the bulb in my bag was a shallot or an onion.
examples.zh: 收银员核实我袋里的那个是「红葱头」还是洋葱。

words.enDefinition: A young mild onion with long green leaves

examples.en: I asked if I could buy a single spring onion rather than a whole bunch.
examples.zh: 我问能不能只买一根「青葱」，不用买一整把。

examples.en: The sign marked spring onion was next to the shelf of fresh herbs.
examples.zh: 标有「青葱」的牌子就在新鲜香草的货架旁。

words.enDefinition: A mild onion relative with a long pale stalk

examples.en: The leek wouldn't fit in my small bag, so I carried it by hand.
examples.zh: 这根「韭葱」放不进我的小袋子，我就拿在手上。

examples.en: I asked whether each leek was sold separately or priced by the bunch.
examples.zh: 我问「韭葱」是按根卖还是按把计价。

words.enDefinition: An edible bulb with a strong distinctive flavour

examples.en: I bought garlic at the farm stand near the bus stop after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在公交站附近的农场直销摊买了「大蒜」。

examples.en: The garlic was in a small basket next to the bags of onions.
examples.zh: 「大蒜」放在小篮子里，旁边是几袋洋葱。

words.enDefinition: A whole head of garlic containing several cloves

examples.en: I bought a garlic bulb because the recipe only called for a few cloves.
examples.zh: 菜谱只要几瓣蒜，所以我买了「一整头大蒜」。

examples.en: The garlic bulb I chose had a dry outer skin with no visible damage.
examples.zh: 我挑的「整头大蒜」外皮干燥，看不出有破损。

words.enDefinition: A long vegetable with green skin and watery flesh

examples.en: I picked up a cucumber to take home after the afternoon study session.
examples.zh: 下午的学习活动结束后，我买了根「黄瓜」带回家。

examples.en: The cucumber I bought at the market was short enough for my lunch bag.
examples.zh: 我在市场买的「黄瓜」够短，能放进午餐袋。

words.enDefinition: A mild summer squash with a thin edible skin

examples.en: I asked whether the zucchini in this crate was priced by weight.
examples.zh: 我问这个箱子里的「西葫芦」是不是按重量计价。

examples.en: My flatmate sent me to the store for a zucchini and two peppers.
examples.zh: 室友让我去店里买一根「西葫芦」和两个甜椒。

words.enDefinition: A tan squash with a bulbous base and orange flesh

examples.en: I chose a small butternut squash that would fit in our shared fridge.
examples.zh: 我挑了一个较小的「奶油南瓜」，能放进我们的共用冰箱。

examples.en: The seller showed me a cut butternut squash with bright orange flesh inside.
examples.zh: 摊主给我看了一个切开的「奶油南瓜」，里面的果肉是鲜橙色的。

words.enDefinition: A vegetable with spongy flesh and usually purple skin

examples.en: I found the eggplant beside the peppers in the small grocery shop.
examples.zh: 我在小杂货店的甜椒旁找到了「茄子」。

examples.en: I bought a small eggplant because I was cooking dinner for one person.
examples.zh: 我只做一个人的晚饭，就买了一个小「茄子」。

words.enDefinition: A large mild pepper with crisp hollow flesh

examples.en: I bought one red bell pepper from the crate under the shelf.
examples.zh: 我从货架下面的箱子里买了一个红色「甜椒」。

examples.en: The shop sold each bell pepper separately, so I didn't need a whole pack.
examples.zh: 店里「甜椒」按个卖，我不用买整包。

words.enDefinition: A small round tomato, often sold in packs

examples.en: I bought cherry tomatoes to share at the study session in our flat.
examples.zh: 我买了些「小番茄」，打算在公寓里一起学习时分着吃。

examples.en: One cherry tomato had rolled to the corner of the plastic container.
examples.zh: 有一颗「小番茄」滚到了塑料盒的角落里。

words.enDefinition: A long green pod eaten whole as a vegetable

examples.en: The market sold green beans loose, so I only took a small handful.
examples.zh: 市场的「四季豆」是散卖的，所以我只拿了一小把。

examples.en: The seller snapped a green bean in half to show how crisp it was.
examples.zh: 摊主把一根「四季豆」掰成两段，给我看它有多脆。

words.enDefinition: Sweet peas with crisp, edible rounded pods

examples.en: I bought sugar snap peas from the stall beside the entrance to campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校入口旁的摊位买了「甜脆豌豆」。

examples.en: The sugar snap peas felt plumper than the flatter peas in the next crate.
examples.zh: 「甜脆豌豆」摸起来比旁边箱子里较扁的豌豆更饱满。

collocations: a bag of sugar snap peas

words.enDefinition: Sweetcorn still attached to its central cob

examples.en: I picked up corn on the cob for the barbecue at our student residence.
examples.zh: 我买了「整穗玉米」，准备在学生宿舍的烧烤会上吃。

examples.en: The farm stand offered corn on the cob in bundles of three that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，农场直销摊的「整穗玉米」三根一捆卖。

collocations: served as corn on the cob

words.enDefinition: A type of fungus commonly used as food

examples.en: I picked up a small pack of mushrooms before walking back to my flat.
examples.zh: 我走回住处前顺手买了一小盒「蘑菇」。

examples.en: I put one more mushroom in the bag before taking it to the scale.
examples.zh: 拿去称重前，我又往袋里加了一朵「蘑菇」。

words.enDefinition: A mushroom with a dark cap and savoury flavour

examples.en: I asked for shiitake mushrooms because those were the ones on my flatmate's list.
examples.zh: 我问有没有「香菇」，因为室友的清单上要买的是这种。

examples.en: The sign showed a shiitake mushroom with a broad brown cap and pale stem.
examples.zh: 标签上画了一朵「香菇」，有宽宽的褐色菌盖和浅色菌柄。

words.enDefinition: An edible mushroom with a wide fan-shaped cap

examples.en: The oyster mushrooms were in a loose cluster at the back of the tray.
examples.zh: 「平菇」在托盘后面，几朵松松地连在一起。

examples.en: One oyster mushroom was larger than the others, so I asked for a smaller cluster.
examples.zh: 有一朵「平菇」特别大，我就请摊主换一簇小点的。

words.enDefinition: The fresh leaves and stems of the coriander plant

examples.en: I asked for cilantro at the grocery store near my campus in California.
examples.zh: 我在加利福尼亚州学校旁的杂货店问店员有没有「香菜」。

examples.en: The cilantro was sold in small bunches next to the spring onions.
examples.zh: 「香菜」是小把卖的，就在青葱旁边。

words.enDefinition: An aromatic herb with soft, fragrant leaves

examples.en: I found basil in little pots on the shelf just above the chilled herbs.
examples.zh: 我在冷藏香草上方的货架找到了小盆栽的「罗勒」。

examples.en: The bag of basil on the lowest shelf had smaller leaves than expected.
examples.zh: 最下面一层的那袋「罗勒」，叶子比我想的小。
